nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real Banach space and let $A, B \subseteq E$ be convex bodies, that is, convex, closed and bounded sets with nonempty interior. If there is $\varepsilon > 0$ with $\operatorname{dist}(a, b) \ge \varepsilon$ for all $a \in A$ and $b \in B$, then there are a nonzero continuous linear functional $F : E \to \mathbb{R}$ and a constant $c \in \mathbb{R}$ with $F(a) \le c$ for all $a \in A$ and $c \le F(b)$…
nodes.title: Separation of convex bodies at positive distance

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be a linear subspace of $E$, not necessarily closed, and let $x \in E$. Then there is a continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$ with $\|f\| \le 1$ that vanishes on $S$ and satisfies $f(x) = d(x, S)$, where $d(x, S) = \inf_{s \in S} \|x - s\|$ is the distance from $x$ to $S$.
nodes.title: Hahn–Banach distance formula, attainment form

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be a linear subspace of $E$, and let $x \in E$ have positive distance $d(x, S) = \inf_{s \in S} \|x - s\| > 0$ from $S$. Then there is a continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$ with $\|f\| = 1$ that vanishes on $S$ and satisfies $f(x) = d(x, S)$.
nodes.title: Norm-one annihilating functional at positive distance

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be a closed linear subspace of $E$ and let $x \in E$ with $x \notin S$. Then there is a continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$ with $\|f\| = 1$ that vanishes on $S$ and satisfies $f(x) = d(x, S)$, where $d(x, S) = \inf_{s \in S} \|x - s\|$ is the distance from $x$ to $S$.
nodes.title: Norm-one annihilating functional outside a closed subspace

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a seminormed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $M$ be a subspace of $E$, let $C \ge 0$ be a real number, and let $f \colon M \to \mathbb{K}$ be a continuous linear functional with $\|f(m)\| \le C\|m\|$ for all $m \in M$. If $x_0 \in E$ does not lie in $M$, then $M$ is strictly contained in $M' = M + \mathbb{K} x_0$, and there is a continuous linear functional…
nodes.title: One-step Hahn–Banach extension

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be a linear subspace of $E$, not necessarily closed, and let $x \in E$. Then the distance $d(x, S) = \inf_{s \in S} \|x - s\|$ from $x$ to $S$ equals the supremum of $|f(x)|$ over all continuous linear functionals $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$ with $\|f\| \le 1$ that vanish on $S$.
nodes.title: Hahn–Banach distance formula

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be a linear subspace of $E$, and give $E/S$ the quotient seminorm. Then for every $x \in E$ the class $q(x)$ of $x$ under the quotient map $q \colon E \to E/S$ satisfies $\|q(x)\| = d(x, S)$, where $d(x, S) = \inf_{s \in S} \|x - s\|$ is the distance from $x$ to $S$.
nodes.title: Quotient seminorm equals distance to the subspace

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be a linear subspace of $E$, and give $E/S$ the quotient seminorm. Then the quotient map $q \colon E \to E/S$, a continuous linear map, has operator norm $\|q\| \le 1$.
nodes.title: The quotient map has norm at most one

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
